title: Kobalos Malware Investigation
description: Investigate and respond to a Kobalos malware infection in a high-performance computing environment, following a realistic compromise lifecycle from initial access to containment.
outcomes: Identify and contain the Kobalos malware
Investigate its behavior and persistence mechanisms
Analyze network communication for command and control (C2) and data exfiltration
Implement containment measures to prevent further lateral movement

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: Investigate and respond to a Kobalos malware infection in a high-performance computing environment. Follow a realistic compromise lifecycle from initial access to containment, including identifying suspicious services, persistence mechanisms, network communication, and implementing containment measures.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the target host (IP: 192.168.50.5) via SSH using the username 'cyrano' and password 'cyrano'.
levels.local_content: Access the target host (IP: 192.168.50.5) via SSH using the username 'cyrano' and password 'cyrano'.

levels.title: Identify suspicious service
levels.content: Investigate the running services on the target host and identify any suspicious services that might be related to the Kobalos malware. The flag is the name of the suspicious service.
levels.solution: Check the status of all services and look for any unusual or unfamiliar services. The suspicious service is named 'payload-transfer.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Start by checking the status of all services.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any unusual or unfamiliar services in the list.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious service is related to payload transfer.

levels.title: Investigate service persistence mechanism
levels.content: Examine the persistence mechanism of the suspicious service identified in the previous task. The flag is the name of the persistence mechanism.
levels.solution: Check the systemd service files and timers related to the service. The persistence mechanism is named 'payload-transfer.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Start by checking the systemd timers.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any unusual or unfamiliar timers in the list.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The persistence mechanism is related to payload transfer.

levels.title: Identify suspicious file
levels.content: Search for suspicious files on the target host that might be related to the Kobalos malware. The flag is the name of the suspicious binary file.
levels.solution: Look for files with unusual names or locations, especially in the home directory of the user cyrano. The suspicious file is named 'fbf0a76ced2939d1f7ec5f9ea58c5a294207f7fe'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Start by searching the home directory of the user cyrano.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for files with unusual names or locations.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious file is a binary that appears to be part of the malware.

levels.title: Identify suspicious outbound IP
levels.content: Analyze network connections and identify any suspicious outbound IP addresses that might be used for command and control (C2) communication. The flag is the suspicious IP address.
levels.solution: Use network monitoring tools to inspect outgoing connections. The suspicious outbound IP address is '192.168.40.5'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Start by checking the network connections.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any unusual or unfamiliar IP addresses in the list.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious IP address is likely a C2 server.

levels.title: Identify suspicious outbound port
levels.content: Determine the port used for suspicious outbound communication identified in the previous task. The flag is the suspicious port number.
levels.solution: Check the network connections and look for the port number used in the communication. The suspicious outbound port is '7070'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Start by checking the network connections again.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for the port number used in the suspicious communication.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The suspicious port is likely used for C2 communication.

levels.title: Identify data exfiltration
levels.content: Investigate whether any data exfiltration is occurring through the suspicious service or network connections. The flag is the name of the log file containing evidence of data exfiltration.
levels.solution: Inspect logs and network traffic for any signs of data being sent to external hosts. The data exfiltration log is named 'payload-transfer.log'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Start by inspecting the log files.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Look for any signs of data being sent to external hosts.

hints.title: Third hint title
hints.content: The log file may contain evidence of data exfiltration.

levels.title: Contain C2 communication
levels.content: Implement measures to contain the C2 communication identified in the previous tasks. The flag is the port number to block.
levels.solution: Use firewall rules or other network security measures to block the suspicious outbound communication. The port to block is '7070'.

hints.content: Start by implementing firewall rules.

hints.content: Look for the port number used in the suspicious communication.
